added_models.model: BIOCAD population PK model simulating a 250 mg Q3W flat dose of prolgolimab

dose.population: Untreated unresectable or metastatic melanoma (FLAT); dose pools tumour types
dose.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC11408354). Model year is a proxy: the popPK simulation preceded FLAT, which started 2022-02 (NCT05783882); the model itself is described only in the trial paper.
dose.note: PopPK model fitted to weight-based MIRACULUM PK chose a 250 mg Q3W flat dose before FLAT dosed it.
dose.quote: The Q3W flat dose was selected based on population PK modeling along with efficacy and safety data on weight-based regimens from the BCD-100-2/MIRACULUM study (NCT03269565).
dose.judgement: Opening entry at first use. Not a retrodiction: the model was fitted to weight-based PK but predicted exposure for a regimen not yet given to anyone.

dose.magnitude_basis: predicted 250 mg Q3W Cmax/Cav/Ctrough at or above 1 mg/kg Q2W vs observed FLAT Ctrough consistently higher than weight-based dosing
dose.population: Untreated unresectable or metastatic melanoma (FLAT); dose pools tumour types
dose.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC11408354). The comparison is with a historical control (MIRACULUM) and the authors caution that bioanalytical methods differed between studies. FLAT has no registry results.
dose.note: Observed flat-dose troughs exceeded weight-based troughs, as the popPK simulation predicted; melanoma patients, not cervical.
dose.quote: Figure 4  illustrates that Ctrough values with flat dosing were consistently higher to weight-based dosing in the overall Ctrough population.
dose.reason: Flat-dose troughs met the predicted exposure
dose.judgement: Dose question scored on exposure only; the non-inferior ORR belongs to efficacy in melanoma, outside this tile. Dose pools tumour types as patient PK, so a melanoma trial counts. No tolerability margin was stated by the model, so margin_stated false. The cervical trials (CAESURA, FERMATA) used weight-based dosing, so this track bears on the class's dosing, not on the cervical readouts.

considered_not_added: Zimberelimab population PK and exposure-response model (Yang 2024, https://doi.org/10.1002/cpdd.1439): fitted to the same patients' 240 mg Q2W data (self-fit, not an independent comparison); its prospective prediction (360 mg Q3W, 480 mg Q4W comparable exposure) has no published patient PK comparison found.

Balstilimab (AGEN2034) preclinical package: no peer-reviewed preclinical characterization or regulator review found (no BLA review public; BLA withdrawn 2021); phase 1/2 dose came from patient PK, not a model.
Geptanolimab (GB226) preclinical package: no published preclinical pharmacology, occupancy or toxicology found; only clinical papers (ASPS, PTCL).

Prolgolimab in-vitro PD-1 occupancy and T-cell activation assays (Gordeev 2024): compared only with pembrolizumab and nivolumab in vitro, never with patient results; its CT26 mouse track is already in the draft.
Cervical cancer patient-derived organoids, PDX or humanized-mouse models, or ex-vivo tumour fragments with any member drug: none found.
Russian registration of prolgolimab for cervical cancer: a regulator decision on trial data (CAESURA), not reliance on model data; not opened.
Human challenge, genetic (PDCD1 loss-of-function) or QSP models for this class in cervical cancer: none found.
